sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the two generated shape IRIs nltl:GeneratedShape_I2_061_CalculationCase and nltl:GeneratedShape_I2_061_Ship with non-vocabulary blank-node shape identifiers (or registered SHACL shape identifiers outside the canonical vocabulary), because deterministic validation rejects both as unknown canonical terms. Preserve the ship target, both supplied relationship paths, hullStructure-owned thickness check with decimal numericValue in metres, required prescribedAnalyticalProcedure, explicit prohibition of directCalculationMethodValue, and the supplied plating/structuralMember applicability scope.
